fields.label: Fallback Contact Name
fields.description: Used only when a guard's SOS call cannot be routed to their own company/farm's Security Head — e.g. no Security Head is configured for their company, or their login has no linked Employee/Security Guard record. Leaving this blank means an unroutable guard gets a hard error instead of a phone number — do not leave blank in production.

fields.label: Fallback Contact Phone
fields.description: E.164 or local format, whatever the calling app dials as-is.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: e.g. "Security Operations Center, staffed 24/7" — shown to whoever reviews SOS routing config, not to the guard.

fields.label: Alert Radius (meters)
fields.description: When a guard triggers SOS, every other guard whose most recent GPS ping is within this radius gets a full-screen push alert with the distressed guard's location. Farm-scale distance, not gate-to-gate — 1500m is a starting default, tune per how spread out your farms are.

fields.label: Ignore Pings Older Than (minutes)
fields.description: A guard's last GPS ping older than this is treated as "not currently trackable" and excluded from the nearby-guard alert — an old ping could place them somewhere they've long since left.
